senses.gloss:
__1 A field under water; meadow; केदारेभ्यस्त्वपोऽगृह्णन्कर्षका दृढसेतुभिः [[Bhāg. 10. 20. 41]]; [[Ms. 9. 38]], 44; cf. the play on words in the [[Subhāṣ.]] के दारपोषणरताः? and the reply is केदारपोषणरताः. 
__2 A basin for water round the root of a tree. 
__3 A mountain. 
__4 A particular mountain forming part of the Himālayas (modern Kedār). 
__5 A form of Śiva. 
__6 N. of a Rāga (in music). 
-Comp. 
-खण्डम् a small dyke, earth raised to keep out water; गच्छ केदारखण्डं बधान [[Mb. 1. 3. 22.]] 
-नाथः a particular form of Śiva.
